recalled_knowledge.item: muon flux at the SURF 4850 ft level 5.3e-9 cm^-2 s^-1 (Majorana Demonstrator 5.31+-0.17e-9); Mei-Hime flat formula 3.8e-9 at 4.3 km w.e.
mean muon energy ~320 GeV at 4.3 km w.e. from <E> = eps(1-e^{-bh})/(gamma-2), eps=693 GeV, b=0.4/km w.e., gamma=3.77
muon-induced neutron yield in rock 3.5e-4 n/(mu g cm^-2) at ~300 GeV (Mei-Hime 4.14e-6 E^0.74 -> 3.0e-4; range 2.5-5e-4)
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: Mei & Hime 2006; Wang et al. 2001; Araujo et al. 2005

recalled_knowledge.item: muon-induced neutron production spectrum: evaporation Maxwellian T~1.2 MeV plus hard cascade tail ~E^-1 to ~50 MeV then ~E^-2 to GeV, hard fraction 0.2-0.4, f(>10 MeV)~0.15-0.25, f(>100 MeV)~0.02-0.04
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: Wang et al. 2001; Mei & Hime 2006; Kudryavtsev et al. 2003

recalled_knowledge.item: muon zenith distribution I ~ cos^n theta with n ~ 3.5 (2.5-4.5) at 4.3 km w.e.
Homestake rock density 2.7 g/cm^3 (2.6-2.9)
n-Si/O cross sections: lambda_tot 7-8 cm, lambda_nonel 14 cm (14 MeV) to ~35 cm (100 MeV) in rock -> escape depth above 8.2 MeV 20/30/40 cm
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: ENDF systematics; nuclear interaction length ~100 g/cm^2

failed_or_abandoned: First implementation of the hydrogen removal term used the per-collision survival probability (1-8.2/E) instead of the removal probability 8.2/E; fixed. The >50 MeV component dominates, so the final expectation changed by <4%.
Mei-Hime analytic rock-neutron spectrum not used because its coefficients could not be recalled reliably; replaced by a two-component parametrisation with scanned hard fraction and knee.
Cavern shape, top/bottom OD tanks and cryostat steel not modelled separately; absorbed in the 2-3 m path-length range.
